verdict.rationale: Cloudflare ships an official Sandbox SDK (docs-34) with an extensively documented API surface. It covers getSandbox(), exec() with streaming and stdin, file read/write and streaming writes, an interpreter with persistent contexts, sessions, watch(), preview URLs and tunnels, and its architecture describes how SDK calls are multiplexed over a single connection. Missing for 10: evidence of more than one SDK (the docs show only a TypeScript/Workers SDK, with no other language SDKs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
